source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top Fury parses
summary: Bloodthirst on cooldown, Whirlwind on cooldown, Heroic Strike as the rage dump (off-GCD). Execute spam below 20%. Maintain Rampage (AP buff on crits). Death Wish on cooldown.

Mortal Strike.note: Arms ability  -  a Fury warrior should not be casting Mortal Strike; check spec

Shield Bash.note: interrupt that requires a shield  -  Fury warriors use two weapons; this suggests a wrong stance or keybind

Shield Block.note: defensive shield cooldown  -  wrong spec for Fury DPS

breakpoint.note: Bloodthirst and Whirlwind should both appear on their respective cooldowns. Heroic Strike is the rage dump  -  it replaces (not delays) the next auto attack when queued, so high Heroic Strike counts with good timing indicate good rage management. Rampage (5-stack AP buff from crits) should maintain near-100% uptime once ramped up.

advisory: Fury is the dominant TBC warrior DPS spec. Dual-wield with fast off-hand maximizes white hit and Whirlwind damage. Death Wish (+20% damage, ~3-minute cooldown) should appear regularly. Execute replaces the normal rotation below 20%  -  a surge in Execute casts at the end of a fight is expected and correct. Berserker Stance vs Battle Stance swap may appear depending on rage and encounter.
